facts.fact: 镜像时刻：父亲没回她的短信——她今早又发一条（她对 Sean 玩过同样的 ghosting）。
facts.anchor: replied to my text from yesterday, so I texted him again this morning.

facts.fact: Mark 年轻时想当厨师改行经商——Sean 的厨艺与乐观都来自父亲（Rain or shine 的 goofy smile）。
facts.anchor: He wanted to be a chef when he was younger, but he eventually went into business instead.

facts.fact: 她向 Sean 全盘交底：Eloise 控制一切，父亲什么都没拦——「Eloise 的规矩，我爸照办」。
facts.anchor: my dad just went with it.

facts.fact: 决裂真相补全：那晚 Eloise 动了手——她当天就离开了这个家。
facts.anchor: She got physical—and I left that day.

facts.fact: 她的自我赦免：疮疤源于对方的自恋与不安全感——「那不是我。我熬过来了」。
facts.anchor: It all stemmed from her own insecurities and narcissistic personality.

facts.fact: 书店计划向 Sean 正式官宣；他答 I’d do anything for you。
facts.anchor: going to open my own bookstore.

facts.fact: Nolan 全案：IED 袭击、十九岁、小队唯一伤亡——survivor's guilt（为什么不是我）。
他的转折句：多年来不敢照镜子——「直到你走进那家店」；你把我带了回来。
章末他 Onion 笑话收泪——「我投你一票，反正你已经在哭了」。
facts.anchor: “Who’s going to chop these onions? I vote for you, because you’re already crying.”
